messages.subject: Strategy & Sustainability Executive | ESG, External Affairs & Country Leadership
messages.body:
Dear Carrie,

Your executive-search work across strategy, operations, sustainability and transformation, including the Middle East, aligns strongly with my background. I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group, leading government and regulatory relations, ESG and social performance, corporate and external affairs, stakeholder strategy, strategic partnerships and executive communications. I am pursuing Director, VP, Country and Regional mandates where strategy must translate into institutional trust, regulatory discipline and responsible execution. Saudi Arabia and the UAE are priority markets, with broader international mobility.

My executive CV is attached for confidential consideration.

Best regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
